title: Tip from Angela - Find All the Hard Working People
summary: Study-habit tip: work where other people are also working to boost motivation.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Studying alone at home makes it easy to put off hard tasks. Being around focused people raises your own effort.
Options: a study buddy, a university or public library, or any quiet place where others are working. Alumni cards can keep university libraries accessible.
Use the setting for the tasks you tend to procrastinate on, and keep going consistently.
